key_findings: MISMATCH root cause found and fixed: all 15 scan()-discovered top-level folder/doc nodes (jaxfne-jaxfne, jaxfne-tests, jaxfne-scripts, jaxfne-docs, jaxfne-examples, jaxfne-tutorials, jaxfne-skills, jaxfne-agents, jaxfne-readme, jaxfne-figures, jaxfne-local, jaxfne-outputs, jaxfne-site, jaxfne-tutorial-outputs, jaxfne-benchmarks) had EMPTY generated.links -- verified via direct read of each node file. Root cause confirmed in repo_mapper.py: scan()'s write_node() calls use links=_existing_links(...) (preserve-only, never sets an initial root link), unlike bootstrap()'s explicit root-linking for the 6 permanent verb nodes. Cross-checked against labyrinth's own repo: its analogous folder nodes (e.g. labyrinth-clients) DO have a manually-added link back to root -- confirming this is a real, pre-existing repo_mapper.py gap that labyrinth's own maintainer worked around by hand for their repo, never fixed in the tool itself, and jaxfne had simply never received the same manual pass.

Fix applied: added {'to': 'labyrinth-jaxfne', 'relation': 'refines'} to all 15 nodes. Result (re-verified via repo_mapper rerun): grammar_violations 9 -> 0, loose_leaves 6 -> 0, balance_flags 32 -> 16 (jaxfne-jaxfne was disproportionately the sole hub before; now root shares the connection load directly).

MATCH review: 15 Pollinate suggestions reviewed. 14/15 are one false-positive class -- Jaccard similarity between the 6 permanent PRP-verb nodes (adapt/progress/review/plan/brainstorm/seal), driven entirely by shared templated summary vocabulary ('...entries tracked... live from X.json', 'prp', 'verb', 'node') -- these are semantically DISTINCT PRP stages, not duplicates. This exact false-positive pattern is independently documented in repo_mapper.py's own code comment above _PERMANENT_NODE_SUMMARIES ('near-identical boilerplate text here was caught for real by Converge during testing'). No merge -- correctly kept separate.

1/15 genuine candidate: jaxfne-outputs <-> jaxfne-tutorial-outputs (score 0.375, both generated-artifact directories). Read both nodes' full content: outputs/ (168 files, 33M, smoke-test/etude/sweep artifacts) and tutorial_outputs/ (6 files, 388K, tutorial-run artifacts) are genuinely distinct in scale/content -- neither subsumes the other (Convergence Principle's similarity-AND-coverage rule: a near-duplicate containing MORE information should not be collapsed away, and neither does here). NOT merged -- but cross-linked in both nodes' related_nodes (they weren't referencing each other before, only both independently referencing jaxfne-tutorials), so a future pass doesn't re-derive the relationship from scratch.
landmines: The scan()-missing-root-link gap is NOT jaxfne-specific -- any NEW repo bootstrapped with repo_mapper.py will have the same 15-ish scan()-discovered nodes start with empty links until manually fixed, exactly as jaxfne did until this pass. Not fixed upstream in repo_mapper.py itself (would need scan() to pass links=[{'to': root_id, 'relation': 'refines'}] plus _existing_links() merged in, not just _existing_links() alone) -- reported as a candidate for that repo's own Adapt/Progress cycle, not fixed here.
